description: 6 frames from a quick pan of a living room: kitchen counter with an orange pill bottle, beige sectional sofa with clothes on it, wooden end tables, a desk with a monitor and a desk lamp by the balcony door, a wall-mounted TV with its power cable running down to an outlet, and a white PlayStation 5 Slim standing on the floor under it next to an open cardboard box. The v2 Appraiser cropped the PS5 as the cable on the wall and the monitor as a desk corner.

items.title: Sony PlayStation 5 Slim
items.notes: Disc or digital edition is not clear at this distance. The crop must show the console, not the cable or outlet beside it.
